title: NQ Runs the fade with the long end!
speaker: Scott Schneider

macro_themes.view: NQ made all-time highs this week despite significant long-term yields, a testament to the strength of the tech auction, though at some point yields may hit sentiment.
Thursday's sell-off on the OpenAI revenue shortfall was later questioned by Bloomberg as accounting differences; Friday just balanced inside Thursday's range.

calls.condition: Above Thursday's ETH high: resume the upward auction toward all-time highs; below Thursday's low: revisit the two-sided trade/value of two weeks prior.
calls.reason: Friday was an inside day balancing within Thursday's double-distribution range; watching last week's POC (31,220), weekly midpoint (31,204), the drifting Sept FOMC-anchored VWAP (~825 shorthand), Thursday's low (~792 shorthand), an unrepaired gap and a virgin POC (~235 shorthand) from the all-time-high day.
calls.quote: it's either going to head us back up towards those alltime highs and continue the upward auction, or we will potentially revisit some of this …

notes: Recorded the weekend after the Fri Oct 9 session (exact day not stated; Sat Oct 10 used). Several levels were given in shorthand (792 = Thursday low/VWAP touch, 825 = FOMC-anchored VWAP, 235 = virgin POC); full handles not stated (likely 30,792 / 30,825 and 31,235 given the 31,220 POC) so they are not in key_levels. No directional bias given.
